title: Equal-compute direct repetition and independent challenge topology trial
claim: With the represented information and model-call budget fixed, independent role separation changes fully warranted synthetic dispositions relative to repeated direct analysis.

compute_contract.synthesis: the same deterministic agreement-only function consumes both arm outputs

information_contract: Both arms receive byte-identical EAL/2 source, process record, options, system instruction and response schema; role instruction is the sole intended manipulation.
assignment: Randomise arm call order within family and execute every assigned call once in a fresh context.
primary_estimand: family-average paired difference in fully warranted disposition, independent roles minus repeated direct
safety_estimand: paired difference in strong false attribution, introduced error, supported-case recall and decisive coverage
analysis: Family-level paired randomisation interval, plus token and latency parity audit before interpreting topology; failures remain in the assigned denominator.
